# cursor_private_workers_summary (Data Source)

Reads connected and in-use private worker counts for the authenticated user and their team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cursor_private_workers_summary" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `team_in_use` (Number)
- `team_total_connected` (Number)
- `user_in_use` (Number)
- `user_total_connected` (Number)
